description: Document structure for Proposal/CRUCIBLE-{question-slug}.md (engage-crucible Step 5). Decision-focused — surfaces the crucible experiment and research roadmap where users can act on them.

sections.title: Hypotheses
sections.description: One section per hypothesis with the full brief, structured experimental-design artefact, and the prior probability.

sections.title: Falsification Attacks
sections.description: One section per attacker with discriminating prediction, siblings ruled out, experimental setup, expected information gain, cost.

sections.title: Bayesian Synthesis
sections.description: Prior table, posterior-landscape table, crucible-experiment call-out, roadmap list.

sections.title: Crucible Experiment
sections.description: Detailed write-up of the highest-information-gain-per-cost experiment.

sections.title: Research Roadmap
sections.description: Ordered sequence of experiments plus conditional-next-steps decision points.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.description: What Bayesian or research-design lesson this case teaches.
